detail.command:
test -f src/courses/data/neon-city.ts && test -f src/courses/data/haunted-mansion.ts || { echo 'Expected local course files are missing'; exit 3; }; python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/courses/data/haunted-mansion.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old='[[-1.6,7],[1.6,11],[-1.3,15]].map'
new='([[-1.6,7],[1.6,11],[-1.3,15]] as [number,number][]).map'
if old in s:
    s=s.replace(old,new,1)
elif new not in s:
    raise SystemExit('Expected Candle Hall expression not found')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run typecheck && printf '\n=== HAUNTED HOLES ===\n' && grep -o "id:'haunted-[0-9][0-9]'" src/courses/data/haunted-mansion.ts | wc -l && printf '\n=== STATUS ===\n' && git status --short
